reason: Panel packing tests a distinct 64 KiB layout and traversal; its potential benefit is unverified and packing work may increase. Prefetching and joint end-pointer checks are smaller changes, but prior pointer-end measurements were mixed and did not establish a gain. Transpose fusion has possible scratch savings but high correctness risk from its assembly rewrite. The proposed indexed-address schedule may add costly address generation. The two-K proposal overlaps the previously measured two-step unroll, so it ranks low. ZA remapping has no source evidence of a bottleneck, and tail handling and A-transpose fusion apply mainly to the fallback rather than n=512. No proposal has measured evidence of reaching 1800 GFLOP/s.
